title: Akathist to the Most Holy Theotokos
subtitle: The original Akathist of the seventh century.
intro: Stand if you are able. The Akathist is sung or read; the refrain at the end of each stanza is repeated by the congregation. This corpus is being typeset; only the opening Kontakion and the first Ikos are shipped today. The remaining twelve Ikoi and twelve Kontakia will follow in a separate content drop.
source: Hapgood Service Book (1906), public domain; refrain wording per the Jordanville Prayer Book.

prayers.title: Kontakion 1
prayers.instruction: Opening hymn. The kontakion is read; the people respond with the refrain.
prayers.text: To Thee, the Champion Leader, do we Thy servants dedicate a feast of victory and of thanksgiving, as ones rescued out of sufferings, O Theotokos; but as Thou art one with might which is invincible, from all dangers that can be do Thou deliver us, that we may cry to Thee:

prayers.title: Ikos 1
prayers.instruction: Read or sung. The salutations build toward the refrain; pause briefly between them.

prayers.title: The remaining stanzas
prayers.text: The Akathist continues for twelve more Kontakia and twelve more Ikoi, culminating in the closing Kontakion (a repetition of the opening). They will be added in a forthcoming content drop, cross-checked against the Hapgood typesetting. If you can help typeset, write team@purify.app.
